'''Keresha Yald''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Warrior]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She occasionally shared her knowledge with other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as a combat instructor.<ref name="TOR" />
